item.description: A new species of dinosaur—a long-clawed predator the size of a large tiger—has been discovered by a UCL-led team from a fossil found on the Isle of Wight. item.title: Pope Leo has cancerous growth removed in lung operation
item.description: Pope Leo XIV had a cancerous growth removed from his right lung in a 90-minute operation on Tuesday and "woke up normally" after the procedure, the Vatican said. item.description: A concept from the field of quantum mechanics, spin is a property of particles that has no direct counterpart in everyday experience. This has resulted in two technologies that are widespread today: magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is commonplace in hospitals, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (NMR) is used to determine the structures of proteins and to develop new drugs. item.description: Ukrainian president’s comments on ‘particularly vile’ strikes come after US threatened to halt intelligence sharing Ukraine received no early warning from its partners about a second night of Russian ballistic missile strikes on civilian infrastructure in Kyiv, including a critical power plant struck after dark, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Tuesday. The Ukrainian president had earlier described an attack involving five missiles on Monday as “particularly vile”. He emphasised that receiving intelligence from Ukraine’s western allies “helps saves lives, and this is one of the most critical… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Luke Harding Senior international correspondent

item.title: ¿Cuáles son las nuevas sanciones de Trump contra la CPI y qué busca lograr con ellas?
item.description: Tras la entrega del Premio Nobel de Paz a Navi Pillay, exjueza de la Corte Penal Internacional (CPI), el Gobierno del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, anunció sanciones contra la entidad, calificando a la institución como ilegítima y desencadenando una ola de rechazo de parte de otros países. En el Invitad@ del día analizamos esta medida con Javier Ruiz, counsel de la Corte Penal Internacional. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
